events.title: Drunk Woodcutter releases December 2nd!
events.summary: The firewood has been stacked, the whiskey poured, and the chalkboard has spoken:Drunk Woodcutter releases on December 2, 2026!I've got a lot in store for the adventurous lumberjack: more unhinged "axes", challenging wood types, and other ridiculous stuff. Want a first taste? The demo is out, and it’s part of Steam Next Fest (October 19-26). Go hurt yourself for beer money!Wishlist the game to get notified on launch day!Cheers,ElSchorscho
